messages:
lee_docs: Hi all — opening a small PR to add a Dedicated provisioning mini-guide: quick YAML, Terraform label example, and a couple SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427

anya_infra: Thanks. Please include a short note about region SKU availability and node affinity failures (we had one customer hit this).

lee_docs: Will do. Draft YAML (keeps fields minimal):
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: DedicatedPool
metadata:
  name: app-team-pool
spec:
  gpu: a100-40gb
  autoscale:
    min_replicas: 1
    max_replicas: 6
    burst: 2
  tenant_isolation: true
```

tom_platform: Quick naming nit: docs should use `tenant_isolation` (snake_case) — matches the REST API. Also add a sentence that setting tenant_isolation on an existing pool triggers a reconcile and rolling restarts.

rita_product: On the SLA wording: avoid saying "no preemption" categorically. Suggest: "Reserved pools are prioritized for availability; in constrained events lower-tier resources may be preempted per SLA; see SLA matrix." Link to updated matrix: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sla-matrix/v3

lee_docs: Good — I'll use exact phrasing from Rita. Adding Terraform label snippet per migration request:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "app_team" {
  name = "app-team-pool"
  gpu  = "a100-40gb"
  tenant_isolation = true
  labels = { migrated_from = "legacy-tenant-23" }
}
```

anya_infra: Add a short CLI migration command example that maps legacy tenant tags to reserved pool labels. Helps ops teams run migrations safely.

lee_docs: CLI draft: `redwoodctl tenant migrate --from legacy-tenant-23 --to-pool app-team-pool --dry-run` (note: dry-run recommended).

rita_product: Can we include small SDK snippets: one JS create, one Python get-SLA metadata? Keep them tiny.

lee_docs: JS create (minimal):
```js
await redwood.dedicated.create({
  name: 'app-team-pool',
  gpu: 'a100-40gb',
  autoscale: { min_replicas: 1, max_replicas: 6, burst: 2 },
  tenant_isolation: true
});
```
Python SLA read sample (tiny):
```py
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
meta = c.get_pool_metadata('app-team-pool')
print(meta['sla'])
```

anya_infra: Note: emphasize that `min_replicas` is advisory under extreme hardware pressure; recommend `min_replicas: 2` for latency-sensitive workloads with warm KV cache. Add that as a short callout.

lee_docs: Adding that callout. Also debating whether to include a one-line cost estimate (ballpark) in quickstart. Thoughts?

rita_product: Include a single-line estimate and mark it clearly as "rough estimate". Product teams find it useful.

qa-bot: docs-check: link-check ok; code-block lint passed.

docs-lint-bot: md-lint: minor heading capitalization suggestions (pushed as suggestions on PR).

tom_platform: I'm leaving an inline PR comment asking to swap the internal /handbook link to https://confluence.redwood.ai/dedicated/ops-guides and to avoid phrasing implying absolute hardware isolation.

lee_docs: Thanks — I'll update links, wording ("reduces noisy neighbor risk; does not imply hardware-level guarantee unless contracted"), add node-affinity troubleshooting bullet, and merge once reviewers approve. Targeting merge Thu.

rita_product: Ping me if legal needs to review SLA sentences before merge.

lee_docs: Will do.
